localName.gloss: the ring one comes back to

description.value: An annular bank of shell, bone and processing waste some two kilometres across and four metres high at its thickest, enclosing a bare working ground that floods at every high water. The bank is still being added to. Occupation certainly runs far deeper than the recorded date; the register simply cannot hold a year before 2190.

notes.value: The founding year here means the year the survey arrived. Four separate attempts have been made to record the real one, and the field will not take the answer.
